lines.beaver_en: National Tax Service help center. How can I help you?
lines.en: I'm calling to ask about a tax imposition.
My freelancer income tax came out too high.

lines.beaver_en: How much was your income last year?
lines.learner: 작년 소득은 천만 원밖에 안 됐습니다.
lines.en: Last year's income was only ten million won.
lines.roman: jangnyeon sodeugeun cheonman wonbakke an dwaetseumnida.

lines.beaver: 그 정도 소득이면 감면 대상일 수 있습니다.
lines.beaver_en: With that income, you may qualify for a reduction.
lines.beaver_roman: geu jeongdo sodeugimyeon gammyeon daesangil su itseumnida.
lines.en: Can I also get a tax exemption?

lines.beaver: 조건이 맞으면 가능합니다. 다른 소득은 없으십니까?
lines.beaver_en: It's possible if you qualify. Any other income?
lines.beaver_roman: jogeoni majeumyeon ganeunghamnida. dareun sodeugeun eopseusimnikka?
lines.learner: 교육부 행사에서 받은 강사료가 조금 있습니다.
lines.en: I have a small lecture fee from a Ministry of Education event.
lines.roman: gyoyukbu haengsaeseo badeun gangsaryoga jogeum itseumnida.

lines.beaver: 강사료도 신고하셔야 합니다. 서류를 내시면 검토합니다.
lines.beaver_en: You must report that too. We'll review your documents.
lines.beaver_roman: gangsaryodo singohasyeoya hamnida. seoryureul naesimyeon geomtohamnida.
lines.en: Do I also report interpreting fees from the Ministry of Justice?

lines.beaver: 네, 모든 기관의 수입을 함께 신고하셔야 합니다.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, you must report income from all agencies together.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, modeun gigwanui suibeul hamkke singohasyeoya hamnida.
lines.en: Yes, I asked because I wanted to know exactly.

lines.beaver: 잘 물어보셨습니다. 감면은 공식적으로 신청해 주십시오.
lines.beaver_en: Good that you asked. Please apply for the reduction officially.
lines.beaver_roman: jal mureobosyeotseumnida. gammyeoneun gongsikjeogeuro sincheonghae jusipsio.
lines.learner: 공식적인 신청은 어디에서 할 수 있습니까?
lines.en: Where can I make an official application?
lines.roman: gongsikjeogin sincheongeun eodieseo hal su itseumnikka?

lines.beaver_en: You can do it on the National Tax Service Hometax site.
lines.en: I see. I'll apply right away today.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have any other questions?
lines.en: No. Thank you for explaining so kindly.
